description: Captain (runcaptain.com) managed file-search API. Each corpus page's provided NV-Ingest markdown is indexed as one document ({corpus_id}.md with a '# {doc_id} - page {n}' header); Captain performs server-side chunking, LLM enrichment, and gemini-embedding-2 dense embedding. Retrieval per query: hybrid BM25 + dense with voyage-rerank-2.5 reranking (candidate pool 200, top 100 chunks), pages ranked by best chunk score (MaxP). One API call per query. Closed API: requires CAPTAIN_API_KEY env var (keys at captain.dev).

hardware_information.num_cpu_cores: n/a (client is a thin HTTP driver, 10 concurrent requests)
hardware_information.runner_note: Submitted runs executed from a workstation over WAN to the API in AWS us-east-1; reported search latency includes ~60-80ms/query network overhead. Bulk corpus indexing was performed once ahead of the runs via Captain's S3 batch-ingestion of the same per-page markdown files; the timed index() in the submitted runs therefore verifies the pre-built collection rather than re-ingesting. Measured ingestion from the indexing jobs: finance_en 2,942 pages in 218s as a single job (74 ms/page); the remaining 16,310 pages were indexed by 7 concurrent jobs completing together in ~16.5 min wall (~60 ms/page effective fleet throughput).

methodology_notes.runs: Each dataset was evaluated 3 times with identical configuration; the submitted JSON is the median run by ndcg_cut_10 (retrieval is mildly nondeterministic, about +/-1pt aggregate).
methodology_notes.tuning: Configuration (MaxP aggregation, candidate pool 200, semantic-only retrieval for the cross-lingual finance_fr set) was selected on 1,416 self-generated dev queries over the public corpus; ViDoRe benchmark queries were never used for tuning.
methodology_notes.fallback_integrity: Every query response was asserted to carry rerank.fallback == null (no silent reranker degradation) from retained raw responses.

nodes.description: Indexes one document per corpus page (provided NV-Ingest markdown) into a per-dataset collection.
Hybrid retrieval over the page-document collection; returns top chunk candidates.
Reranks a 200-candidate pool; final chunk scores are aggregated to pages by MaxP.

edges.description: Indexed page documents form the retrieval corpus.
Candidate chunks are reranked, then aggregated to page-level rankings.
